attribution.title: Spiegelhof, Nieuwe Spiegelstraat 3-17 / Keizersgracht 555, Amsterdam (1917-1919 office and arcade wing)
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012167897 (CC0): the stone-and-brick office at the Keizersgracht corner with its rusticated granite base, arched barred cellar lights, fluted pilasters, attic storey, mutule cornice, two pediment risalits, chamfered corner and balustrade with urns; the entrance portico with its pediment and ball finials; the Nieuwe Spiegelstraat wing with its colonnaded shop arcade, white-framed casements, cornice, the central loggia pavilion and the south pavilion under pediments, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
